title: The Kelly--Trotter conjecture and dimension of poset products
summary: We study the order dimension of Cartesian products of finite posets. Kelly and Trotter conjectured in 1982 that $\dim(P\times Q)\ge\dim P+\dim Q-2$ for all finite posets $P$ and $Q$. For $m\ge3$, let $R_m$ denote the incidence poset of the complete graph on $m$ vertices. We prove that there is a constant $C$ such that, for all sufficiently large $m$, $\dim(R_m\times R_m)\le\left(1+\frac{2}{\log_2 6}\right)\dim R_m+C$.
